Official Creighton University Apparel & Spirit Store

Welcome to the Creighton University Apparel & Spirit Store – the official online destination for licensed Bluejays apparel, gear, and accessories. Whether you're a student, alumni, or fan, we offer the largest selection of authentic Bluejays merchandise to showcase your school pride. Shop trusted brands and exclusive collections only available at the official Creighton University Apparel & Spirit Store.

 

Shop the Latest Bluejays Gear

Stock up on the newest Bluejays t-shirts, Bluejays sweatshirts, Bluejays hats, and more to represent your favorite school. Explore styles for men, women, and youth, plus accessories and essentials for every Bluejays fan.

Bluejays Back to School Collection

Start the semester strong with officially licensed Bluejays Back to School gear. From sweatshirts and tees to hats and backpacks, we have everything you need for campus life. Whether you're in class or cheering at the next game, shop Bluejays apparel designed for comfort and school pride.

Bluejays Home, Office & Tailgate Essentials

Upgrade your space with Bluejays home and office gear or get ready for game day with Bluejays tailgate and outdoor gear. From décor and drinkware to chairs and coolers, show off your Bluejays pride everywhere.

Trending Bluejays Gear & Fan Favorites

Browse the hottest Bluejays apparel and accessories, including hoodies, jackets, polos, and collectible items. With thousands of officially licensed products, you’ll find the perfect addition to your wardrobe or dorm setup.

Exclusive Bluejays Collections & Special Releases

  • Bluejays Vintage Apparel
  • Bluejays Game Day Essentials
  • Bluejays Alumni Gear
  • Bluejays Graduation Gifts

Your Home for Official Creighton University Apparel & Spirit Store Merchandise

Whether you’re preparing for the semester, shopping for gifts, or refreshing your game day outfit, the Creighton University Apparel & Spirit Store has you covered. Shop today and celebrate your Bluejays pride with authentic gear you can only find here.
